records.title: Agentic World Modeling for 6G: Near-Real-Time Generative State-Space Reasoning
records.reason: O-RAN causal state-space world model; reports 2.3–4.1x faster inference vs attention/hybrid baselines, but is network telemetry prediction rather than LLM generation; RWKV/RetNet relation is indirect.

records.title: MemoChat: Tuning LLMs to Use Memos for Consistent Long-Range Open-Domain Conversation
records.reason: Memo write/retrieve tuning improves long-range conversation consistency; no inference cost/cache/latency evaluation. LongNet relation is only long-context adjacency.

records.title: Health system learning enables generalist neuroimaging models
records.reason: Clinical MRI/CT NeuroVFM representation and diagnostic/reporting evaluations; no technical relation to FlashAttention kernels or LLM inference.

records.title: Full-Stack FP4: Stable LLM Pretraining with Quantized Projections, Optimizers, and Attention
records.reason: NVFP4 quantization recipes are evaluated for LLM pretraining; paper distinguishes its objective from inference-focused attention and reports limited block-level efficiency, not end-to-end inference.

records.title: Claw-SWE-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating OpenClaw-style Agent Harnesses on Coding Tasks
records.reason: Benchmark compares coding agent harnesses and reports runtime/API costs; it proposes no inference optimization method, and KV-cache lineage is not technically established.
